<![CDATA[vrmlscript:
 function toggle( stime ) {
 if( state )
 {
  state = FALSE;
  pause = stime - snd.startTime_changed;
  snd.set_startTime = -1;
  snd.set_stopTime = stime;
 }
 else
 {
  state = TRUE;
  snd.set_startTime = stime - pause;
  snd.set_stopTime = 0;
 }
}

                      "javascript:\r",
                      "\t\tfunction initialize()\r",
                      "\t\t{  \r",
                      "\t\t\tvar TempColor = new SFColor();\r",
                      "\t\t\t\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\tif (Steps < 0)\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tSteps = 0;\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\tvar a= alpha.length >= Colors.length;\r",
                      "\t\t\tvar al;\r",
                      "\t\t\t\r",
                      "\t\t\t// Initialize the pixeltexture\r",
                      "\t\t\tColorArray.length = Colors.length + (Colors.length-1)*Steps;\r",
                      "\t\t\tif (Hsv)\r",
                      "\t\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tvar HSVTemp1;\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tvar HSVTemp2;\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tvar HSVResult = new MFFloat();\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tfor (i=0; i < (Colors.length-1); i++)\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\tHSVTemp1 = Colors[i].getHSV();\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\tHSVTemp2 = Colors[i+1].getHSV();\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\tfor (j=0; j < (Steps+1); j++)\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t{  \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tHSVResult[0] = ((HSVTemp1[0] * (Steps+1-j)) + (HSVTemp2[0] * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tHSVResult[1] = ((HSVTemp1[1] * (Steps+1-j)) + (HSVTemp2[1] * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tHSVResult[2] = ((HSVTemp1[2] * (Steps+1-j)) + (HSVTemp2[2] * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.setHSV(HSVResult[0], HSVResult[1], HSVResult[2] );\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tif (a) {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tal = alpha [i];\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tColorArray[i*(Steps+1) + j] = ColorToGrayA(TempColor,al);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\telse ColorArray[i*(Steps+1) + j] = ColorToInt(TempColor);\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\telse\r",
                      "\t\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tfor (i=0; i < (Colors.length-1); i++)\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\tfor (j=0; j < (Steps+1); j++)\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t{  \r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tif (bands) {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.r = Colors[i].r;\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.g = Colors[i].g;\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.b = Colors[i].b;\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t} else {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.r = ((Colors[i].r * (Steps+1-j)) + (Colors[i+1].r * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.g = ((Colors[i].g * (Steps+1-j)) + (Colors[i+1].g * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTempColor.b = ((Colors[i].b * (Steps+1-j)) + (Colors[i+1].b * j))/ (Steps + 1);\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tif (a) {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tal = alpha [i];\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tColorArray[i*(Steps+1) + j] = ColorToGrayA(TempColor,al);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t\tColorArray[i*(Steps+1) + j] = ColorToInt(TempColor);\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\tif (a) {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tal = alpha [Colors.length-1];\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tColorArray[ColorArray.length-1] = ColorToGrayA(Colors[Colors.length-1],al);\r",
                      "\t\t\t}\r",
                      "\t\t\telse ColorArray[ColorArray.length-1] = ColorToInt(Colors[Colors.length-1]);\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\tif (a) {\r",
                      "\t\t\t\tcolorTexture = new SFImage(1, Colors.length + (Colors.length-1)*Steps, 2, ColorArray);\r",
                      "\t\t\t} else \r",
                      "\t\t\t\tcolorTexture = new SFImage(1, Colors.length + (Colors.length-1)*Steps, 3, ColorArray);\r",
                      "\r",
                      "\t\t\t// Updating by routed events\r",
                      "\t\t\tcolorTexture_changed = colorTexture;\r",
                      "\t   }\r",
                      "\t\tfunction ColorToInt(Color)\r",
                      "\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\tTemp = ((Math.round(Color.r*255) << 16) + \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t (Math.round(Color.g*255) << 8) + \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t  Math.round(Color.b*255));\r",
                      "\t\t\treturn Temp;\r",
                      "\t\t}   \r",
                      "\t\tfunction ColorToIntA(Color,a)\r",
                      "\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\ta = a*255;\r",
                      "\t\t\tTemp =  ((Math.round(a) << 24) +\r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t (Math.round(Color.r*255) << 16) + \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t (Math.round(Color.g*255) << 8) + \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t Math.round(Color.b*255));\r",
                      "\t\t\treturn Temp;\r",
                      "\t\t}   \r",
                      "\t\tfunction ColorToGrayA(Color,a)\r",
                      "\t\t{\r",
                      "\t\t\tTemp =  ((Math.round(a*255) << 8) + \r",
                      "\t\t\t\t\t Math.round(Color.r*255));\r",
                      "\t\t\treturn Temp;\r",
                      "\t\t}   \r",
                      "\t\t"

                                  "vrmlscript:",
                                  "function move(t){",
                                  " keyValues[0]=curPos;",
                                  " values_changed = keyValues;",
                                  " vWalk=0;",
                                  " k2Walk=kWalk;",
                                  " startMove = t;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function isActive (v,t){",
                                  " if(!v){",
                                  "  if(newMove){newMove=false;move(t); }",
                                  "  else stopw(t);",
                                  " }",
                                  "}",
                                  "function walk(v,t){",
                                  " if(watched){",
                                  "  fWalk+=(v-vWalk)*k2Walk;",
                                  "  vWalk=v;",
                                  "  while(fWalk>=1)fWalk-=1;//mod!",
                                  "  while(fWalk<0)fWalk+=1;//grr!",
                                  "  walkFrac=fWalk;",
                                  " }",
                                  "}",
                                  "function setRot(v,t){",
                                  " rot_changed=v;",
                                  " if(v[3]!=angle){",
                                  "\tangle=v[3];",
                                  "\tdir.x=Math.sin(angle);",
                                  "\tdir.z=Math.cos(angle);",
                                  " }",
                                  "}",
                                  "function setPos(v,t){",
                                  " d=v.subtract(curPos);",
                                  " if(d.length()==0){",
                                  "  if(moving)stopw(t);",
                                  "\treturn;",
                                  " }",
                                  " kWalk=d.dot(dir)*ooStep;",
                                  " if(isPilot){",
                                  "  if(!moving)startw();",
                                  "  if(kWalk>0.2)kWalk=0.2;",
                                  "  fWalk+=kWalk;",
                                  "  while(fWalk>=1)fWalk-=1;//mod!",
                                  "  while(fWalk<0)fWalk+=1;//grr!",
                                  "  walkFrac=fWalk;",
                                  "  pos_changed=v;",
                                  "  return;",
                                  " }",
                                  " keyValues[1]=v;",
                                  " if (moving)newMove=true;",
                                  " else if(notFirst){startw();move(t);}",
                                  " else{pos_changed=v;notFirst=true;}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function startw(){",
                                  " moving=true;",
                                  " tsIdle.enabled=false;",
                                  " welder.Gstart=-1;",
                                  " fWalk=0;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function stopw(t){",
                                  " tsIdle.enabled=false;",
                                  " tsIdle.set_stopTime=t+0.3;",
                                  " tsIdle.set_startTime=t;",
                                  " tsIdle.enabled=true;",
                                  " moving=false;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function idle(b,t){",
                                  " if(!b){",
                                  "  if(!moving){",
                                  "   tsIdle.set_stopTime=t+30+60*Math.random();",
                                  "   tsIdle.set_startTime=t;",
                                  "   welder.G10=t;",
                                  "  }",
                                  " }",
                                  "}",
                                  "function initialize(){",
                                  " notFirst=false;",
                                  " ooStep=1/stepLength;",
                                  "}",

                                  "vrmlscript:",
                                  "function move(t){",
                                  "keyValues[0]=curPos;",
                                  "values_changed = keyValues;",
                                  "vWalk=0;",
                                  "k2Walk=kWalk;",
                                  "startMove = t;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function isActive (v,t){",
                                  "if(!v){",
                                  "if(newMove){newMove=false;move(t);}",
                                  "else stopw(t);",
                                  "}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function walk(v,t){",
                                  "if(watched){",
                                  "fWalk+=(v-vWalk)*k2Walk;",
                                  "vWalk=v;",
                                  "while(fWalk>=1)fWalk-=1;",
                                  "while(fWalk<0)fWalk+=1;",
                                  "walkFrac=fWalk;",
                                  "}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function setRot(v,t){",
                                  "rot_changed=v;",
                                  "if(v[3]!=angle){",
                                  "angle=v[3];",
                                  "dir.x=Math.sin(angle);",
                                  "dir.z=Math.cos(angle);",
                                  "}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function setPos(v,t){",
                                  "d=v.subtract(curPos);",
                                  "if(d.length()==0){",
                                  "if(moving)stopw(t);",
                                  "return;",
                                  "}",
                                  "kWalk=d.dot(dir)*ooStep;",
                                  "if(isPilot){",
                                  "if(!moving)startw();",
                                  "if(kWalk>0.2)kWalk=0.2;",
                                  "fWalk+=kWalk;",
                                  "while(fWalk>=1)fWalk-=1;",
                                  "while(fWalk<0)fWalk+=1;",
                                  "walkFrac=fWalk;",
                                  "pos_changed=v;",
                                  "return;",
                                  "}",
                                  "keyValues[1]=v;",
                                  "if (moving)newMove=true;",
                                  "else if(notFirst){startw();move(t);}",
                                  "else{pos_changed=v;notFirst=true;}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function startw(){",
                                  "moving=true;",
                                  "tsIdle.enabled=false;",
                                  "welder.Gstart=-1;",
                                  "fWalk=0;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function stopw(t){",
                                  "tsIdle.enabled=false;",
                                  "tsIdle.set_stopTime=t+0.3;",
                                  "tsIdle.set_startTime=t;",
                                  "tsIdle.enabled=true;",
                                  "moving=false;",
                                  "}",
                                  "function idle(b,t){",
                                  "if(!b){",
                                  "if(!moving){",
                                  "tsIdle.set_stopTime=t+30+60*Math.random();",
                                  "tsIdle.set_startTime=t;",
                                  "welder.G10=t;",
                                  "}",
                                  "}",
                                  "}",
                                  "function initialize(){",
                                  "notFirst=false;",
                                  "ooStep=1/stepLength;",
